placements.title: From an informal new-hire ramp to one checklist every hire completes
placements.frame: What does each new hire's first week require, and what has the standard checklist replaced in how new people are brought in?
placements.why: Wren's statement describes a standing onboarding process: every new hire completes the same checklist (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) in week one, and it replaced the old wiki page. Onboarding is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding, so it is a theme rather than a one-time fact. No existing leaf covers how people are brought into the organization, and the only existing leaf concerns instrument calibration.
consulted: STRATA REFERENCE: Organization > Process, OrgByDomain, CoreWorkflows (no exact fit for a new-hire onboarding category)
